experiment: C05 matched-seat promotion of the v6 candidate policy against shipped v5, measured through one common frozen evaluator
authored_at_checkpoint: C05 second freeze review response (review commit 3905689656635918baa9c0b31aea39b3f179780c)

amendment_justification.measurement_split: The v5 control evaluator predates per_season_playoff/per_season_champ, so v3's design (each arm measured by its own checkout's evaluator) makes the paired playoff/championship gates structurally inconclusive - the two-checkout rehearsal proved the control receipt necessarily carries null proxies. v4 separates POLICY identity from MEASUREMENT identity: each arm's frozen checkout produces only its policy/draft outputs; one common frozen accepted-C02 measurement evaluator replays both outputs to derive every outcome sample. Both arms are then scored by identical rules and all frozen gates become decidable.
amendment_justification.provenance: Receipts additionally freeze mechanical tooling provenance (clean committed tooling head containing the harness, execution-module hash, effective-manifest hash) per the second freeze review.
amendment_justification.immutability: promotion-v3.json and promotion-v3-exec-v1.json are preserved byte-for-byte; this version is append-only.

inherited_frozen_terms.from: promotion-v3.json (sha256 above), unchanged and incorporated by reference
terms: league_configurations (216 mandatory ids via promotion-v2 hash)
seasons [2021, 2024] and held_out_seasons [2018] with the held_out_rule
seed_derivation (base seeds, eval-seed formula, stream offsets, bootstrap seed formula)
calibration_gates (player-calibration-v1 by hash) and its missing_report_interpretation
limits (12 h wall, 8 GiB RSS, free local compute)

calibration_evidence_disposition: The accepted C02 calibration report is executed evidence and FAILED the frozen calibration thresholds (1QB/2QB spearman deltas negative). It is preserved without reinterpretation: under the inherited calibration gate the candidate cannot promote unless a NEW accepted calibration report passes every threshold. Runtime attestations may fill only genuinely unexpressed report fields and must not reinterpret failed benchmark deltas or non-computable cohorts.

policy_vs_measurement_identity.policy: WHAT each arm decides: the draft/policy code of the arm's own frozen checkout. Control policy = baseline_sha; candidate policy = the combined candidate SHA frozen in promotion-v4-exec-v1.json. Policy code is the experimental variable.
policy_vs_measurement_identity.measurement: HOW outcomes are scored: one common frozen accepted-C02 measurement evaluator replays both arms' draft outputs under identical trajectories. Measurement code is held constant across arms and is NOT part of the experimental variable.
policy_vs_measurement_identity.rule: No arm may be measured by its own checkout's evaluator; a receipt whose measurement identity differs from the frozen measurement evaluator is invalid.

measurement_evaluator.definition: blitz_engine.simulation.season_eval.evaluate_rosters at the accepted combined C02-C04 head, with build_players/matrix inputs from the frozen board corpus and EvalConfig(n_seasons=8, seed=eval_seed, waiver_cost=0.0)
measurement_evaluator.verification_rule: before any measurement run, every listed file in the measurement checkout must hash-match; a mismatch aborts (BLOCK), never degrades

two_stage_protocol.stage_1_draft: Inside EACH arm's frozen checkout (import-resolution pinned and hard-asserted): build the frozen board for (year, league_id), run the arm's own draft_league with the derived eval seed and the frozen policy mix. Output = a DRAFT RECEIPT recording the per-seat rosters as player_id lists plus all pairing keys. No outcome metric is computed at this stage.
two_stage_protocol.stage_2_measure: Inside the frozen MEASUREMENT checkout only: verify measurement file hashes, load both arms' draft receipts, validate pairing (identical board_hash, seat_policy, eval_seed, year, league_id, base_seed; rosters must partition the same board), then evaluate_rosters each arm's rosters under the SAME derived eval seed - identical injury/availability/waiver trajectories by construction (CRN). Output = a MEASUREMENT RECEIPT per arm carrying started-points, H2H, playoff, and championship per-season samples.
two_stage_protocol.analysis: pair_slice/evaluate_promotion consume only measurement receipts; all inherited gates, CI methods, and interpretation rules apply unchanged.

draft_receipt.board_hash: sha256 of the sorted (player_id, position, projection) board
draft_receipt.rosters: player_id[][] - one list per seat, draft order preserved

measurement_receipt.draft_receipt_sha256: sha256 of the exact draft receipt file measured
measurement_receipt.arm_run: the ArmRun object (per_season, h2h, playoff and championship proxies, pairing keys)

write_once_stage_separation: receipts land under <out>/draft/fit/, <out>/draft/confirm/, <out>/measure/fit/, <out>/measure/confirm/; an existing path refuses overwrite; the HeldOutGuard year/stage check precedes every stage; confirm-stage receipts may not exist before the fit verdict is recorded

exact_commands.note: concrete argv is produced by the (yet-to-be-implemented) v4 harness; the frozen shapes are:
exact_commands.draft_arm: git worktree add --detach <scratch>/arm-<name> <arm_sha>; then from the tooling root: <venv-python> -m blitz_engine.promotion (v4 harness) draft --arm <name> --checkout <scratch>/arm-<name> --expected-sha <arm_sha> --year <Y> --league-id <ID> --base-seed <S> --stage <fit|confirm> --out <receipts>/draft/<stage>/  (subprocess pins the ARM checkout's engine/, strips editable finders, hard-asserts blitz_engine resolution)
exact_commands.measure: git worktree add --detach <scratch>/measure 7b3fd73578943b992402ad693259a3e92358da69; then: <venv-python> -m blitz_engine.promotion (v4 harness) measure --checkout <scratch>/measure --draft-receipt <path> --out <receipts>/measure/<stage>/  (verifies measurement file hashes, then evaluate_rosters with n_seasons=8, seed=eval_seed, waiver_cost=0.0)
exact_commands.implementation_status: NOT implemented; frozen here first per the second freeze review, awaiting its own freeze review before any code
